description: Who acts on each line of .local/progress.log, and what to do. `python3 scripts/progress.py follow <role>` prints only the lines routed to that role, with its note; the file keeps every line as the record. A line is matched against `lines` ("<source> <state>", fnmatch patterns) top to bottom, and the first rule that matches decides; `to` maps each role that should act to its note, and an empty `to` routes the line to nobody. A line no rule matches goes to main. A role never gets the lines it wrote itself.
